title: Koi pooche jo wafa
body:
koi pooche jo wafa aur wafadar ki baat
bas usay yaad dila dena alamdar ki baat
<<DIVIDER>>
waada e tifli na shabbir ka poora hota
khaiz guzri na badi ran mein alamdar ki baar
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
hujjate haq se bhi jab baat na maani jaaye
tabdali karte hai talwar se talwar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
jaan di ki na magar kufr ki bayyat hargiz
rakh li is tarha se jarrar ne jarrar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay hussain ibne ali teri shahadat ki qasam
reh gayi taaba abad ahmed e mukhtar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk namoose mohamed ke nikal padte hai
yaad aa jaati hai jab shaam ke bazaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
nange sar ahle haram haath mein oonton ki muhaar
poochta kaun bhala abid e bemaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame shabbir hai gham saare zamane ka urooj
hai ye baat is jahan ki nahi do chaar ki baat
koi pooche jo...
author: Urooj Bijnori
